site.heroHeadline: I am an independent Illustrator and brand designer with 9 years of experience.
site.about: An illustrator and visual storyteller based in Copenhagen. His work explores playful shapes, bold color, and narrative composition. After studying design at the Royal Danish Academy of Design, he began working with studios and publishers.

testimonials.author: Leo Bennett
testimonials.quote: They brought structure and personality to our brand in a way that immediately made everything feel more confident, polished, and cohesive.

testimonials.author: Nina Carter
testimonials.quote: Working together felt effortless from start to finish. They translated a rough idea into a visual identity that felt clear, expressive, and genuinely memorable.

testimonials.author: Ethan Brooks
testimonials.quote: They have a rare ability to make complex ideas feel simple and beautiful. The final result was thoughtful, strategic, and full of character.

testimonials.author: Maya Flores
testimonials.quote: The new visuals gave our launch a completely different energy. Everything felt intentional, distinctive, and much more aligned with the audience we wanted to reach.

testimonials.author: Miles Rivera
testimonials.quote: The illustrations added warmth and personality without losing professionalism. It made the whole brand feel more human, modern, and engaging.

testimonials.author: Sofia Grant
testimonials.quote: From the first concepts to the final files, every detail was handled with care. The work felt refined, playful, and incredibly easy to build a brand around.

testimonials.author: Gillian Anderson
testimonials.quote: What stood out most was the balance between creativity and clarity. The system felt original, but it also worked beautifully across every touchpoint.

testimonials.author: Tom Turner
testimonials.quote: They helped us move from scattered inspiration to a brand that finally felt unified. The result looked distinctive and instantly more mature.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I provide illustration, brand identity design, and visual systems for digital and print projects.

faqs.question: What does a typical project process look like?
faqs.answer: Most projects follow three stages: discovery, concept development, and final delivery.

faqs.question: How long does a project usually take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary depending on the scope, but most projects take between 2–6 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. I collaborate with clients worldwide and work primarily through online communication.

faqs.question: Can you adapt illustrations to our brand style?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every project is tailored to fit the tone, personality, and visual language of the brand.

faqs.question: How can I start a project with you?
faqs.answer: Simply send a message through the contact form with a short description of your project.

works.title: The Northern Times
works.describe: We built the visual system around clarity and rhythm — reflecting how news moves in real time. Modular layouts, bold typography, and restrained color allow stories to take center stage without distraction. The result is a system that adapts seamlessly across platforms, from fast-moving digital feeds to long-form editorial.

works.title: Nitty Craft Co.
works.describe: We approached the brand through tactility — bold forms, raw textures, and playful compositions. The packaging system feels hands-on and expressive, turning everyday products into small collectible objects. Each element was designed to feel unique yet cohesive, encouraging interaction and repeat engagement.

works.title: Oxbridge Press
works.describe: The concept focused on timelessness and precision. A refined typographic system paired with subtle illustration details creates a balance between academic heritage and contemporary publishing. This approach ensures consistency across a wide range of publications while maintaining a distinct identity.

works.title: Barcelona Civic Office
works.describe: We developed a flexible identity system designed to unify diverse city initiatives. Bright colors, simple shapes, and clear hierarchy make communication accessible across digital and physical spaces. The system scales easily, supporting everything from public signage to campaign materials.

works.title: Südstadt Zeitung
works.describe: The design explores contrast — tradition and modernity coexisting. Clean grids meet expressive editorial accents, creating a visual language that feels both familiar and forward-looking. This balance helps the publication stand out while remaining approachable to a broad audience.

works.title: Monochrome Journal
works.describe: We stripped everything back to essentials. A minimal palette and sharp typographic rhythm create a calm, focused reading experience where content defines the aesthetic. The reduced visual noise allows each story to resonate more clearly with the reader.

works.title: The Economic Review
works.describe: We centered the identity around structure and data. Precise layouts, subtle motion, and analytical visual cues reinforce clarity and trust in complex information. The system supports both quick insights and in-depth analysis without compromising readability.

works.title: The Chronicle
works.describe: The system is built on narrative flow — guiding the reader through layered stories. Warm tones, editorial typography, and soft transitions create a more human, immersive news experience. This approach strengthens emotional connection while preserving editorial credibility.
